A2_safe_operation_algebra.validation: PR #317 / head@166a72590a3acf55da9f9a7aa717afc71bb7023f passed quality, bilingual-sync, and reference-integrity
A2_safe_operation_algebra.scope: for a quotient q, generic safe finitary operations are the classical equivalence polymorphisms Pol(ker q); for a declared ambient operation family A, the project-specific natural spectrum is Spec_A(q)=A intersect Pol(ker q); the full concrete safe unary monoid reconstructs nondegenerate quotient kernels while restricted natural languages can retain only coarser invariants such as translation period capacity
A2_safe_operation_algebra.layering_boundary: declared future/context language and observation select the operational future-safe quotient through P023/P024; the surviving natural operation spectrum is derived from that quotient plus the declared ambient operation family and does not by itself select a unique quotient
A2_safe_operation_algebra.precision_boundary: scalar precision/scale is a coordinate or complexity measure when available, not a replacement for the quotient plus declared future-operation structure
A2_safe_operation_algebra.prior_art_boundary: partition-preserving transformation semigroups, Pol(theta), congruences, quotient algebras, clones and generic partition refinement are prior mathematics; P008 complete-growth rigidity/spectrum specializations retain their stated WIP proof status

P018_P023_power_free_action_basis.statement: for O_a(q)=R_r(floor(q/a)) on 0..N, a positive action set separates every exact state iff it contains every positive r-power-free b<=N; the positive r-power-free actions are the unique least separating set under inclusion
P018_P023_power_free_action_basis.local_boundary: O_a(q-1) != O_a(q) iff q=a*t^r for some t>=1
P018_P023_power_free_action_basis.prior_art_boundary: power-free arithmetic and generic distinguishing/Test-Cover/minimal-language machinery are prior mathematics; novelty of the exact quotient-root packaging remains unverified

P018_centered_prime_radius.scope: elementary centered-coordinate re-expression of P018 Stage-8 near-diagonal factor-proof slack: under the stated left-prime and size-range hypotheses, the minimal positive symmetric prime radius is slack+1 and the shell state is localized by a difference of squares
P018_centered_prime_radius.boundary: does not assert a symmetric prime pair for every center and does not prove Goldbach-type statements

P022_geodesic_hcp_core.scope: exact finite/combinatorial P022 executable formulas for A_p and simple-cubic geodesic multiplicity plus an integer-coordinate ABAB HCP contact graph with degree 12, exact graph distance, shells, and independently cross-checked shortest-path counts
P022_geodesic_hcp_core.boundary: geometry executable specialization only; generic witness-count/correspondence algebra belongs to A4/A2, and no floating-point Euclidean sphere-center model is being smuggled in

P022_barlow_stacking_core.scope: periodic Barlow close-packed contact graph with exact integer/combinatorial graph distance and geodesic multiplicity, FCC/HCP reconstruction, and root-to-target-layer cumulative interface-sign-count compression for those queries
P022_barlow_stacking_core.boundary: the cumulative-prefix compression is task-relative to the declared root-to-layer distance/geodesic-count queries; Barlow precision, periodic-growth, coordination-observable and observation-history theories are not included

P022_barlow_task_relative_precision.scope: for a selected target layer, (abs(k), delta_k) exactly recovers the two effective interface-sign counts and therefore the vertical witness polynomial required by the declared root-to-layer distance/geodesic-count language; first moments recover delta_k; selected-layer imbalance vectors are coarser than the complete prefix trajectory
P022_barlow_task_relative_precision.negative_boundary: the complete prefix-imbalance trajectory reconstructs the literal stacking word, so selected-layer precision is not whole-history sufficiency
P022_barlow_task_relative_precision.publication_boundary: periodic-growth, coordination-observable and observation-history descendants remain separate later P022 promotions

P022_barlow_periodic_growth.promotion: PR #296 / current L4 from source validation PR #267
P022_barlow_periodic_growth.scope: exact periodic Barlow shell-total geodesic formulas from prefix imbalance, period drift D, positive growth equation (lambda-2)^(2L)=2^(L+|D|), finite drift-deviation bounds, and a universal eventual C-finite annihilator/recurrence class determined by period length and absolute drift
P022_barlow_periodic_growth.negative_boundary: the universal annihilator may be nonminimal, and equal (L,|D|) can give the same class-level growth equation/universal recurrence space while finite shell-total sequences and phases still differ
P022_barlow_periodic_growth.publication_boundary: coordination-observable and observation-history descendants remain separate later P022 promotions

P023_partial_operation_quotient.scope: finite deterministic partial operations F_a:D_a->X; quotient compatibility preserves enabledness/domain membership and target quotient class; iterative refinement gives the coarsest compatible refinement and equals legality-sensitive bounded-word observation equivalence
P023_partial_operation_quotient.total_case: when every D_a=X, the construction reduces exactly to canonical P023 total-operation family closure up to partition-label renaming
P023_partial_operation_quotient.undefined_boundary: an absorbing UNDEFINED totalization is a verification representation only when distinguished and absorbing; it is not promoted to an ontic/world state
P023_partial_operation_quotient.prior_art_boundary: partial transition systems, automata/behavioral equivalence, sink totalization and finite partition refinement are prior mathematics; no generic novelty claim

E001_residual_conservation_slice.permanent_alias_horizon: finite response quotient visibility can be nonmonotone before an exact finite budget after which aliases never return; reachable anisotropy, not unreachable deeper structure, controls the exact observable horizon
E001_residual_conservation_slice.boundary_shell_degree: for fixed represented depth K in dimension n, R_{n,K}(d)=d^n-(d-K)^n has exact discrete degree n-1 while the full coarse-contact box has degree n
E001_residual_conservation_slice.phase_saturation: for endpoint-clearance sum C and collapse factor d, C>=2d-1 gives 2(d-1) interaction phases and C-2d+1 transmitting phases; further displacement adds transmission phases only
E001_residual_conservation_slice.staged_projection_negative: two finite staged projections can differ by order through one returned-budget quantum even when the undeformed rational product commutes; this is a pure integer comparator, not a laminate constitutive law
E001_residual_conservation_slice.physical_boundary: finite application specialization only; no hidden continuum, probability law, laminate constitutive law, or universal material physics is inferred
